verdict.rationale: Trello documents an official REST API with key generation, delegated auth and OAuth1.0, plus batch, search and webhook endpoints, and an official Power-Up Skeleton starter project for building Power-Ups. That gives developers a first-party surface to build against. However, no official language SDK or client library is evidenced, the React/TypeScript sample comes from a third party (App Fox), and probes found no OpenAPI spec from which SDKs could be generated. Missing for 10: named official SDK packages in common languages, first-party typed client libraries, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of SDK use.
